title: Ruined towns and hunting infected
features: Willow Bay airport beside West Road with flights between all five towns
Full real-time flight durations, saved progress and passenger cabin activities
Four town challenges: beach cleanup, market orders, woodland orienteering and harbor cargo
Streamed roadside fencing, vegetation, farm buildings and rest places
Separate quarantine and infected timelines; infected hide behind cover, investigate noise and chase on sight. No cure for bites.
Dark blackout world with torch, ruined storefronts, rubble and wrecked cars
Outbreak-only infected faces, damaged clothing and hunched running animations
online_rooms: A separate room service is still required.
